messages:
jordan: Heads-up — trying to land PR #17933 before the weekend freeze. CI's failing on integration tests, looks flaky. Need a quick decision: rebase & rerun now or wait for the next rebase window? :clock1:

sasha: Can you paste the failing job logs? :eyes:

jordan: Sure — snippet below, failing on the payment integration mock timeout.
```
FAIL test_payments_integration.py::test_charge_retry - TimeoutError: Mock server didn't respond
Workspace: ./tests/integration/payments
Last green: branch 'main' at 6765380000
```

matt: I can kick a rerun and watch. If it's truly a mock flake we can usually get green with one rerun. If it's a real regression, rebase won't help. Want me to rerun now? :thumbsup:

jordan: Please rerun. Also note this PR changes an auth header flow — low blast radius but still prefer landing before freeze if safe.

ci-bot: Build 17933-integration rerun requested by matt at 6765432165 — queued.

sasha: If matt sees repeated failures, we should opt for a small rebase + canary landing. Avoid pushing to main during the freeze window. What's the freeze start time again?

jordan: Freeze starts 2026-03-21T18:00Z. We have ~24h. If this is flaky we can do a manual canary to Dedicated first (no public rollout) and watch traces.

matt: Rerun finished — one test failed again, same timeout. I'm going to run the payment mock locally and add a tighter timeout to the test to see if it's masking a race. Will update in 15.

sasha: Thanks — if you can't get reproducible in 30m ping @eng-oncall and we can decide to hold. Also leave a note in the PR description with your findings so release knows rationale.

matt: Quick update — reproduced locally, appears to be intermittent delay in mock startup under parallel tests. I pushed a tiny fix to the test harness in a patch branch (17933-fix/mock-startup). If jenkins/circleci agrees we can rebase main onto that branch and try one final run.

jordan: OK let's rebase+rerun once matt confirms CI passes on the patch branch. If it fails >2 times we wait for the next rebase window.

ci-bot: Patch branch build 17933-fix/mock-startup passed integration at 6765432350.

matt: Patch looks green. Jordan — want me to open a short-lived merge PR to rebase main onto the fix branch and tag for landing before freeze?

jordan: Yes, please. Tagging @sasha for quick approval after CI. We'll keep the canary guard in deployment config. :white_check_mark:
